take.en: Open-source enterprise world model — bitemporal knowledge graph plus ontology so agents reason on governed facts, not a flat vector dump.

why.en: Most agent stacks still treat company knowledge as chunks in a vector store. Utopia puts time and ontology in the base layer: facts carry validity windows, conflicts surface for review, and decisions leave an audit trail on hardware you control.

explanation.en: Utopia is DeepLethe's Apache-2.0 Rust + Postgres product for offline enterprise knowledge. You get a full app (console, graph browser, ontology workbench), hybrid search, agentic RAG with tools, and a bitemporal graph where every entity and fact keeps when it held in the world and when the system changed its mind. Cold-start ontology packs (schema.org, PROV-O, FOAF, and more) grow with the corpus; temporal Datalog derives new facts with full provenance. Any OpenAI-compatible chat and embedding endpoint works, including fully air-gapped setups.

howItWorks.en: Clone the repo and run docker compose --profile app up -d, then open localhost:1516 and register — first account is admin. Point system settings at your chat and embedding models, create or open a knowledge base, and ingest PDFs, office files, web, RSS, GitHub, or Jira. The built-in agent searches documents, entities, fact history, and mounted databases over multi-turn tool use. Review queues catch low-confidence merges and axiom conflicts instead of silently writing bad edges.

different.en: Not another RAG UI and not a video world simulator. The product story is knowledge governance as infrastructure: bitemporal facts, growing ontology, conflict detection, decision ledger, and Ontology2SQL over mounted Postgres so agents query docs and structured data against one shared model.

x.en:
Utopia is the open enterprise world model play. bitemporal knowledge graph + ontology in the base layer so agents reason on governed facts with audit trails, not another vector dump. self-host Rust + Postgres, air-gap friendly.
